comparison.objective: Calibrate gripper force using a spring reference; candidate tunes a damper from repeated carriage-stop dynamics and locks the setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Applying gripper force to a spring reference and reading calibration versus bimanual mechanical unlocking, fine collar rotation, relocking, physical control actuation, and impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Gripper-force calibration accepted versus two energy-rated stops meeting stroke, rebound, overload, hard-stop, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both concern force-related calibration, but one calibrates sensing/actuation against a spring while the other physically commissions energy absorption and retention. No spec versions or calibration thresholds were provided, so fine rubric similarity cannot be assessed; the available objectives remain meaningfully distinct.
